name: Forbidden material is found BY NAME, because the regulation gives it no identification number

messages.content: A supplier wants to ship ammonium chlorate. Look it up and tell me its hazard class.

name: Free text from a supplier email is classified through the untrusted-content tool

messages.content: Our supplier emailed: '2 drums sulphuric acid soln 60%'. What is it?

name: The signature refusal: table says O, a barrier is asserted, and 177.848(e)(3) still refuses

messages.content: Put UN1830 sulfuric acid and UN1748 calcium hypochlorite on one truck. We have physical barriers between them. Check whether that is legal.

name: An illegal single-vehicle load is split across vehicles by the solver, not by the model

messages.content: I have UN1090 acetone, UN1830 sulfuric acid and UN1748 calcium hypochlorite. Find me a legal way to split them across at most two trucks.

name: A material with no identification number can still be placed on a load

messages.content: Check a load containing ammonium chlorate by name together with UN1090 acetone.

name: Committing requires the approval token the check issued, never a bare assertion that it passed

messages.content: The load passed. Export the shipping paper.
